positions.title: Graphics Programmer
positions.description: Developing techniques for capturing and rendering 3d image/video content for autostereoscopic displays.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Blocks, a VR app designed to make 3d modeling easy and fun.
- Poly, a web app to provide developers with quick access to 3d models.
- Teli, an interactive live-streaming improv comedy show.

various prototypes…
unstructured lightfield capture with smartphones, VR audio synthesizer, VR file explorer, VR coding environment, 3d interactive scene creation on the web, WebAR shopping prototypes

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
Worked as a part of Prof. Ken Perlin's research group.
- Reverse engineered the HTC Vive’s Lighthouse protocol to provide 6dof tracking
to arbitrary devices. Used Raspberry Pi and IR photodiodes.
- Used OpenVR, node.js, and WebSockets to access HTC Vive tracking in web
browsers before WebVR was available.
- Began initial prototypes to port Chalktalk to VR and AR devices. Created a wireless
3dof-tracked controller to draw on any surface using a camera & projector.
- Implemented structured light depth scanning techniques, as an attempt to achieve
high frame rate 3d scanning.
